## Body

F212 (#254): Copilot lost-login recovery, plus the proxy survey/sim method (11-19).

Mechanism facts: auth errors in ~/.copilot/session-state/*/events.jsonl are `session.error` with errorType `authorization` + statusCode 401, or errorType `query` with message `Execution failed: GitHub credential authority error: …` (no code). Use the `infoType: authentication` info events to rule out /login rotation (never print their messages: they carry account names). Copilot's auth code is in prebuilds/<arch>/runtime.node (Rust); cli-main.js has only the slash-command table. `strings -n 8 runtime.node | grep -oE '<phrase>[^.]{0,80}'` gets readable fragments.

Copilot /restart: `{name:"/restart", help:"Restart the CLI, restoring supported live sessions in this process"}`. It only works with COPILOT_LOADER_PID set (npm loader; pij-spawned seats have it, check with /bin/ps -E -ww -p <pid>, not the shell's procps ps). A live probe kept seat id, native session, spawn_id, role holdings and held FYIs across two restarts; only the pid changed. It does drop the seat row's cache_proxy stamp on re-registration.

Design that was approved: detection in the extension (the daemon does NOT tail events.jsonl; the extension sees native events live via session.on). Report after the run's idle publication by chaining on the bridge's `this.activity` promise. The daemon decides; the restart is a `restart` control (COPILOT_COMMANDS only; the fixture's `commands` stays all-harness so OMP never takes it), typed through the pane gate.

Traps:
- NativeBridge.emit(kind, details) spreads details AFTER kind, so a `kind` field in the details silently renames the event. Use another key.
- In daemon integration tests, setting services.tmux is not enough: services.interaction (InteractionGate) still holds the old tmux. Set both.
- shared-build refuses under 25 GiB free and the machine sits at about 25. Free only your own lane's target/worktrees (`git worktree remove --force` on merged ones). Never override the floor; leave clippy and the full Rust tests to CI and say so in the PR.

Proxy survey/sim (Jordan asked directly): scripts in the main checkout's scratch/proxy-survey/{survey,sim}.py. Proxied = usage_record `isByok: true` (`byokKind local_user`). Price from `copilotUsage.totalNanoAiu` and tokenDetails. The empirical re-pricing (rate per prompt token by regime × model × idle gap) calibrates exactly; a structural TTL model was off by 30-70%, so don't use one. Finding: the proxy wins at 5-60 min gaps (0.36x) and loses on hot turns (1.9x per token), because BYOK Copilot flips availableToolCount 17x as often as plain and 74% of flips re-write the whole prompt at the 1h price (35% of proxied spend). Handed to the prime and pm-004.
